reviews.text: This is one of the cute sets from Fwee. It comes with a highlighter that has a keychain which you can bring anywhere with you. Highlight your cheekbones, nose bridge and cupid’s bow in a breeze! I also love the shade and texture of the lippie. It is somewhat jellyish and can be applied easily. It has a sweet candy scent which I love. It is warm on the lips and doesn’t stain. It moisturizes the lips making it look full and plump. I haven’t had any irritations using it.
reviews.zh: 呢個係 Fwee 其中一個得意嘅套裝，入面有一支可以掛喺鎖匙扣上、邊度都帶得去嘅 highlighter。可以輕鬆咁 highlight 顴骨、鼻樑同 cupid's bow！我亦都好鍾意唇膏嘅色號同質地，有少少 jelly 嘅感覺，輕易搽得到。佢有陣甜糖果嘅香味，我好鍾意。搽喺唇上有暖暖嘅感覺，唔會染色。佢滋潤嘴唇，望落去脹卜卜又飽滿。用咗一段時間都冇敏感。

reviews.text: I wasn’t expecting the mini keychain jelly was also in shade sugar powder, so technically I got double of the same thing. Of course, shade sugar powder is more of a jelly highlighter gloss, so there’s not so much color towards it. The formula is quite moisturising, but just gotta break down the formula first before using.
reviews.zh: 我冇預到個迷你鎖匙扣 jelly 都係 sugar powder 色號，所以等於同一樣嘢有兩份。當然，sugar powder 呢隻色比較似 jelly highlighter gloss，所以顏色上唔算好重。配方幾保濕，但使用前要先喺手背或者指腹推開個配方。

reviews.text: The texture is super glossy and not goopy at all, and has a pleasant scent to it. The shade Rosy Glaze is very pretty but just a little difficult to see on medium brown skin tones or two toned lips, so don’t expect too much pigment. However I actually like the sheerness of it and think it’s quite pretty. It also doesn’t last very long so you have to carry it around with you
reviews.zh: 質地超級有光澤但又完全唔黏笠，仲有陣好好聞嘅香味。Rosy Glaze 呢隻色好靚，但係喺中棕色膚色或者雙色唇上面就比較難顯色，所以唔好期望有太強嘅顯色度。不過我自己其實幾鍾意佢嗰種通透感，覺得好靚。仲有，佢持久度唔算高，所以要隨身攜帶。

reviews.text:
I got the color JP01 Sugar Coat, and I'm really happy with my color choice!

The product in this shade is the perfect cheek and lip brightener— it makes my lips and cheeks look more naturally dewy and flushed. I like to apply it to both my lips and my cheeks as a lipgloss, blush, and highlighter.

The color is somewhat buildable, but I would recommend wearing something underneath it (like another blush or another lip tint) if you want more depth.

The product has a dewy finish and blends out really well on the skin. It does tend to fade a bit throughout the day (especially on the lips), so you might need to touch it up a bit when wearing it out for longer periods of time (longer as in 6-9+ hours).

I know fwee sells their own applicators for these pots, but I've had no problems using my fingers and makeup brushes.

I'm not sure how long this one pot will last me (I don't use it daily), but it's been 2 months or so, and I still have a good amount of product.
reviews.zh:
我揀咗 JP01 Sugar Coat 呢隻色，自己都好滿意揀咗呢隻色！

呢隻色嘅產品係完美嘅面珠、唇部提亮產品——可以令到嘴唇同面珠望落更自然水潤同有紅暈感。我會搽喺唇上同面珠，當唇彩、胭脂、highlighter 一齊用。

顏色有少少可以層疊，但如果想再有層次感，建議喺下面搽層其他嘢（例如另一款胭脂或者唇液）。

產品有水光感，喺皮膚上好容易推開。佢會隨住一日過去有少少脫色（特別係喺唇上），所以出街耐啲（6-9 個鐘或以上）可能需要補一補。

我知 fwee 自己有賣呢類 pot 嘅專用 applicator，但我用手指同化妝掃都冇問題。

唔知呢一 pot 可以用幾耐（我唔係日日用），但已經過咗大概 2 個月，仲有唔少貨。

reviews.text: I thought the colour payoff would be a bit more pigmented. It doesn’t show much on my lips unfortunately so I’ve been using it for my cheeks, but it’s so sheer that I need to use a couple of layers. I probably won’t repurchase this in the future.
reviews.zh: 我以為顯色會再強啲。可惜喺我唇上冇咩色，所以我都係用喺面珠，但佢真係太通透，要搽幾層先得。將來應該都唔會再回購。

reviews.text: Obsessed with the color of this! Looks so good on my lips and is moisturizing as well! It looks so cute on my cheeks too but definitely gets a bit sticky so don’t press anything on your cheek. Adds a very healthy glow to skin but needs to be tapped in and not rubbed.
reviews.zh: 我完全迷上咗呢款嘅顏色！搽喺唇上好好睇，又保濕！搽喺面珠都一樣咁得意，不過佢確實會有少少黏笠，所以唔好再掂自己塊面。可以為皮膚加上一種好健康嘅光澤，但要用印嘅方式上妝，唔好嚟去捽。

reviews.text: Very nice, soft red colour on the lips. And very comfortable on the lips. Only four stars because the staying power is not very long and it is nearly impossible to pick up with a brush, so you have to get your fingers in there, which is not the most hygenic,...
reviews.zh: 搽喺唇上係好靚、好柔和嘅紅色，嘴唇亦都好舒適。俾四星係因為持久度唔算高，而且幾乎唔可能用掃去沾取產品，所以一定要用手指去攞，咁樣就唔算最衛生……

reviews.text: It’s soooo cute 🥰 the color is pigmented didn’t expect it . Got the color jm01 compute and blurring pot in the shade wavy . Such a lovely lip combo. In the video couldn’t twirl it in one hand for the color to appear . Best way is to twirl the jelly pot for the product to show. Will definitely be repurchasing other colors to try .
reviews.zh: 真係超得意 🥰 顏色好顯色，之前完全冇預到。我買咗 jm01 compute 同埋 wavy 嘅 blurring pot。呢個唇色組合真係好正。片入面一隻手好難單手扭到佢出顏色。最直接嘅方法就係扭 jelly pot 等產品出嚟。一定會回購其他顏色試。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
